items.caption: A modern redraw of 也 in a seal-script style. Later accounts report 也 as the sound element in an alternative old spelling of 姐; this image shows that graph, not an early form of 她.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style drawing of 也 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the graph named in the reported sound analysis of an alternative old spelling of 姐, while leaving 她’s historical construction unresolved.

limitations.text: No early artifact or manuscript image of 她 is available to show its earliest form or establish its historical relationship to 姐. The 也 illustration is a modern redraw and cannot fill that gap.
